question: Related Questions Q. Where one should look while listening the khutba? 2937 views Q. I am serving in private organisation some 50km from city.There are more then 300 employes in our organisation.A Masjid is built by the adminstration which has capacity of about 400 nimazis.Due to some reasons, adminstration does not allow employees to go out for Salatul Jumah.Also ,for security reasons adminstration does not allow outsiders to come and offer jumah in project masjid.Therefore a very large numbers of employees donot offer Salatul Jumah. Hazrat Mufti sb, Pl. guide us that is it correct to leave Jumah prayer under these circumstances? Some of our friends says that it is not advisible to shed a Farz permanantly. 1968 views Q. Second Jumah 1853 views Q. In our Masjid we have 2 Jumu'ah Salaat due to lack of space. The time is very limited so by the time the 2nd Jumu'ah Salaat ends, within 10 minutes Asr time starts. As such most of the musallees who come for 2nd Jumu'ah also want to perform Asr. But the official Asr Jama'at conducted by the main Imam takes place 1 hour after. The other Imam who leads the second Jumu'ah is insisted upon to lead this unofficial Asr Jama'at. Let me tell you a little bit about the Masjid: -We have an appointed Imam -We do not have an appointed Mu'azzin -We have a group of local people who come for every Salaat What procedure should be taken to conduct this unofficial Asr Jama'at without making it Makrooh Tahrimi or Makrooh Tanzihi in Hanafi Mathab? 3268 views Q. Kuhtuba 5599 views Q. JUMA PRAYER 29430 views Q. Asalamualaikum I would like to find out the ruling concerning whether istimaa' is necessary for women when listening to the juma khutbah live over the radio. It has become the norm for "Islamic" radio stations to play the juma khutbah live, sometimes for more than an hour. Generally the womenfolk are engaged in cooking and don't pay much attention to it. 1. Would the normal laws of listening to a khutbah apply here ie is it wajib? 2. Would it make a difference whether the khutba is played before zawaal or after? 3. Do menfolk also have to listen attentively? What if they have already performed juma? 4-A person who doesn't listen attentively talks while listening will he be sinful? 1917 views Q. Please tell me if Jumuah salah is fardh or wajib? Please provide detail about Jumuah salah 3982 views Q. Assalamualeykum Mufti Saab, We are writing to you from Kinshasa, The Democratic Republic of Congo. There are some Masail we would like to know regarding Jumma prayers. There is a big company here in Kinshasa where many of our brothers (Sunni) work, and they reside in the same compound of the company. The owner of the company is a Muslim also (Sunni), he has built a very small masjid / Ibadad khana for the brothers working in the company to pray namaz. We got to know from the brothers residing there that there is no 5 times Azaan that gets called out and no 5 times Namaaz that takes place, it only takes place sometimes. And the masjid does not totalize 40 people in prayers. The owner of the company thinks that there are 5 times prayers with azan taking place in his company, whereas there isn?t. The Owner of the company does not reside in the company compound, and he spends a lot of time out of the country. Outside the compound nearby, there is a masjid (8-10 minutes walking distance) where 5 times namaz takes place with Azaan, and Jumma prayers aswell. The question is Mufti saab, does the Masjid in the company have the right to conduct Jumma Namaz, is the Jumma namaz accepted under the above circumstances? 2152 views Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Jumuah & Eid Prayers Question ID: 21650 Country: India Title: How many rakath Sunnah are to be offered during Jum'ah salaah.Some say it is two sunnah before fardh and two after.But some say it is 4 sunnate muakkida before and after and 2 sunnate ghair muakkida.Can you please make it clear how many sunnat-e-muakkida and how many ghair muakkida during Jum'ah salaah? Question: Assalamualaikum, How many rakath Sunnah are to be offered during Jum'ah salaah.Some say it is two sunnah before fardh and two after.But some say it is 4 sunnate muakkida before and after and 2 sunnate ghair muakkida.Can you please make it clear how many sunnat-e-muakkida and how many ghair muakkida during Jum'ah salaah? wassalam. Answer ID: 21650 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 725/506/L=1431) There are four rak?at sunnah muakkada before Jumuah salah while after Jumuah salah there are four rakat sunnat muakkadah and two rakat sunnat ghair muakkadah. سن سنة مؤكده.....منها أربع قبل الجمعة ....و منها أربع بعدها (طحاوى على مراقى الفلاح فصل في بيان النوافل، ص:213). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
